content.caption: Google Research logo in the header of the WikiSkill paper's first page
content.description: A small horizontal wordmark logo reading "Google Research" on a white background. "Google" uses the standard multicoloured Google lettering: a blue "G", red "o", yellow "o", blue "g", green "l" and red "e". It is followed by the word "Research" in gray sans-serif type. The logo contains no arrows, connections, marks or other components. In the page context it sits at the top left of the page header, opposite the date 2026-08-28, and identifies the paper as a Google Research publication. This matches the authors' Google Research affiliation.
